scenes.say: In Qatar a set of tyres can do twenty-seven laps at most. After that it has to come off.
The limit was announced on November twentieth. Laps count across the whole weekend, practice included.
The race is fifty-seven laps, so every driver has to stop at least twice.
Blame the fast right-handers from Turn twelve to fourteen. Drivers take them almost flat out.
The left front takes the worst of it. It hits the wear limit after roughly twenty-five laps.
In twenty twenty-three it was eighteen laps, after the sidewalls suffered on the high kerbs.
It was a brutal night: Sargeant retired with dehydration, and Ocon was sick in the car.
Last year the limit was twenty-five. McLaren didn't pit under the safety car, and Verstappen won.
The race is on November twenty-ninth. Check the start in your own time zone on LapRadar.

title: Qatar: a tyre set lasts 27 laps at most, so expect at least two pit stops
